chunks: But those who believe in God and His apostles and make no distinction among any of them, will be given by Him their recompense; for God is forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to make no distinction among the prophets?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *Tawhid al-Rusul* (Unity of the Prophets), affirming that true faith requires belief in all prophets without hierarchical distinction, a view that validates the continuity of divine guidance from Adam to Muhammad (PBUH). It serves as a theological foundation for the Shia understanding of the *Imamate* as the natural extension of prophetic authority, promising divine reward for those who maintain this holistic belief. The emphasis on God's forgiveness and mercy highlights the spiritual accessibility of this unity for the faithful.
